prompt.generated_prompt_string: A high-fashion studio photoshoot of an adult woman sitting confidently on a modern beige chair inside a compact cube room fully covered with vintage newspaper-like print. The paper layouts are grayscale, abstract, and unreadable. She wears a fitted opaque red top, white skirt, red-and-white canvas sneakers, and black cat-eye sunglasses, with loose dark wavy hair. Give her a relaxed pose with one hand touching her hair, legs crossed, and sneakers visible in the foreground. Use cinematic soft studio lighting, centered box perspective, ultra-realistic fashion photography, sharp tactile detail, natural skin texture, and portrait 4:5 framing. No readable text, logo, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, readable newspaper text, logo, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed, warped room geometry
